newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes three cents down at 14.62 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes three cents down at 14.62 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell three cents to 14.62 ringgit ($5.82) a kg as the domestic market saw continued selling despite an overnight rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME), dealers said.
"There were lots of initial offers and buying only came in at the lower level," said a dealer. The LME rose $20 overnight.

Dealers reported initial offers of 177 tonnes against bids of 124. Final turnover was 162 tonnes against 117 on Wednesday, and was absorbed by Japanese, European and local interests. The local premium against London fell to $30 a tonne from $50.
